description:
Your Impact

The GTM Business Systems Director serves as the business owner of GTM capabilities, requirements, and adoption for the systems our GTM teams run on (CRM, CPQ, CLM, and related systems). They act as the business owner of how all DISCO’s GTM teams work and what they need from their systems. As a recognized expert in GTM business systems, they partner with DISCO’s Business Transformation team and business executives to define the medium- and long-term GTM business capability roadmaps. They partner closely with Business Technology so that prioritized business needs are delivered through the Corporate Technology roadmap and change process.

What You'll Do

  • GTM Business Roadmap & Prioritization: Define the roadmap for GTM applications and manage capability roadmaps to ensure tooling scales with corporate strategy. Own the ranked list of GTM business capability needs and the business case behind each. Make final prioritization and tradeoff calls on competing requests within GTM, bringing a unified list to IT.
  • GTM Business Systems Product Ownership: Partner with GTM, Operations, Customer Experience, Finance, and other teams to capture business needs, synthesize them, and translate them into functional requirements.
  • AI Integration in GTM Workflows: Leverage the latest best practices and AI features to accelerate GTM performance and business system ROI.
  • UAT, Acceptance & Change Management: Define acceptance criteria before build, run user acceptance testing, and own training, communications, and adoption for GTM releases.
  • GTM Demand & Tradeoff Decisions: Serve as the decisive voice on which GTM business needs matter most and which are deferred. Understand the bigger corporate picture to effectively make tough tradeoff decisions on implementation sequencing and screen/rank system requests on ROI.
  • GTM Process Standards Ownership: Own the process governance and standard operating procedures for how GTM teams use their systems, ensuring out-of-the-box capabilities are leveraged before resorting to custom technical debt.
  • GTM Team Mentorship: Serve as a mentor and role model for business systems and operations professionals across the organization, guiding teams to leverage best practices.

Who You Are

  • 15+ years of experience in Business Systems, Business Architecture, Internal Product Management, or Revenue Operations.
  • Proven experience setting enterprise-level strategy, influencing C-suite decisions, and driving alignment across departments.
  • Experience with agile methodologies, writing rigorous functional specifications/user stories, and managing tradeoffs.
  • Demonstrated experience running UAT, training, and adoption programs for enterprise systems.
  • Expertise in modern GTM platforms, understanding software capabilities well enough to challenge proposed solutions.
  • Exceptional collaboration and executive presence, with the ability to set business strategy with a CRO and immediately pivot to speaking functional behavior with IT partners.
  • Knowledge of complex business processes (e.g., Lead-to-Cash) and how data must flow across multiple platforms.
  • Knowledge of SOX / public company compliance practices to ensure compatibility with DISCO’s SOX compliance responsibilities.
  • Bachelor's degree required.

Even Better If You Have…

  • Master’s degree in Business Administration, MIS, or Economics
  • Lean Six Sigma certification
 

 

Authorization to Work in the U.S.: Candidates must be legally authorized to work in the United States without sponsorship now or in the future. DISCO is not currently sponsoring visas, including, but not limited to, H-1B, TN, or EAD, and we are not accepting visa transfers.

Perks of DISCO 

  • Open, inclusive, and fun environment
  • Benefits, including medical, dental and vision insurance, as well as 401(k) 
  • Competitive salary plus RSUs
  • Flexible PTO 
  • Opportunity to be a part of a company that is revolutionizing the legal industry
  • Growth opportunities throughout the company

About DISCO

DISCO provides a cloud-native, artificial intelligence-powered legal solution that simplifies ediscovery, legal document review and case management for enterprises, law firms, legal services providers and governments. Our scalable, integrated solution enables legal departments to easily collect, process and review enterprise data that is relevant or potentially relevant to legal matters. 

At DISCO, we believe AI is a core enabler of how work gets done. All employees are expected to proactively adopt and responsibly use AI tools to drive efficiency, improve outcomes, and continuously evolve how they operate in their role.

Are you ready to help us fulfill our mission to use technology to strengthen the rule of law? Join us! 

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.
